notes: Create your own characters: + Create on the main menu opens a 4-step editor (Basics, Character sheet, Schedule, World).
Upload a picture for any character you make; it shows on their card and page.
✨ AI helpers: write the short summary from the sheet, and suggest a full weekly schedule from their job and habits.
Put a character in an existing world (they share its city and clock) or give them a brand-new world with its own scenario, opening and start time. Leave the opening empty and the AI writes it.
New worlds get the full realism rules and their own lorebook automatically.
Edit, delete, export and import your characters (share them as a file).
Characters marked under 18 are automatically kept age-appropriate.
